Proud to share that NTangible has been nominated for the 2026 Built in Canada Awards.

When we started building NTangible, the sports industry had tools for every measurable physical attribute - but nothing rigorous for the mental side. No validated way to quantify how an athlete performs when the moment tightens.
The Clutch Factor™ changed that. Our cognitive assessment platform now serves collegiate baseball programs, national fastpitch organizations, and professional racing teams.

This nomination is a signal that what we're building matters beyond the field. Canadian sports tech. Purpose-built. Pressure-tested.

Thank you to Build Canada, The Peak, TD Innovation Partners, and Simple Ventures for the recognition.

Proud to recognize Elliot Sones - NTangible's ML Research Intern - on earning a finalist spot at the 2026 Ontario Universities Sports Analytics Coalition event!

Elliot is a Computer Science student at Toronto Metropolitan University focused on reinforcement learning, transformer architectures, and applied AI. Since joining NTangible, he's been exploring real-world applications of machine learning in sports psychology and performance analytics.

Earning a finalist nod at OUSAC while actively contributing to an early-stage sports tech startup is no small thing. It reflects the kind of curiosity and drive that moves this industry forward.

If you're in the sports analytics or sports tech space and want to connect with a young builder doing serious work - his portfolio is worth a look: elliotsones.com

Congrats, Elliot. The work speaks for itself.
